title: Sign encoding of a finite sum
statement: Let $\iota$ be a type, let $S$ be a finite subset of $\iota$, and let $a_i\in\mathbb{F}_2$ for each $i\in\iota$. Encode each $b\in\mathbb{F}_2$ by the unit $(-1)^b$ in the integers. Then the encoding of the sum of the $a_i$ over $S$ equals the product of their encodings: $(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}a_i}=\prod_{i\in S}(-1)^{a_i}$, with the sum taken in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns an element of $\mathbb{F}_2$ to each $i\in\iota$
